penalties.authority: Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal
penalties.details: The Customs, Excise and Service Tax Appellate Tribunal has set aside the order passed by the learned Commissioner of Central Excise, Customs and Service Tax, Nashik-II, dated December 14, 2016, which had disallowed the CENVAT credit and imposed a penalty of Rs. 5,00,000 on the Head Office of the Company at Thane. The Company had filed an appeal against the said order, pursuant to which the Appellate Tribunal set aside the order of the Commissioner by allowing the CENVAT credit and reducing the penalty imposed on the Head Office of the Company to Rs. 1,00,000.
penalties.impact: No impact on financial, operational or other activities of the Company except the penalty amount of Rs. 1,00,000.
